facts.business: Finolex Cables Limited manufactures electrical cables, wires, and related products for power, data, and industrial applications across India.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matter: Impairment of investment in joint venture Finolex J-Power Systems Limited (carrying value Rs 110.91 crore net of impairment Rs 208.57 crore) involving significant judgement in estimating future cash flows and discount rate.

key_risks: Forward-looking statements based on assumptions that may not materialize
Impairment risk on investment in joint venture Finolex J-Power Systems Limited due to financial performance and brought forward losses
Dependence on estimates of future cash flows and discount rates for impairment assessment
